programs.description: Somali pirates attack the Maersk Alabama, a container ship, while it is on its course to Kenya. Richard Phillips, the captain of the ship, uses his wits to negotiate with them to save his crew.
After the police inform them about their parents' mysterious disappearance, two siblings embark on a mission to uncover the truth.
A geriatric gangster's release from prison leads to a reunion with his two partners in crime, one of whom has orders to kill him.
Maria Altman, a Jewish refugee, along with her lawyer Randy Schoenberg, faces several difficulties while reclaiming the painting of her aunt, which was seized by the Nazis before World War II.
The Bride, who's now pregnant, sets off to kill her ex-boss and lover Bill, his brother, Budd the bouncer, and one-eyed Elle.

programs.showName: The Perks of Being a Wallflower
programs.description: Charlie, a 15-year-old introvert, enters high school and is nervous about his new life. When he befriends his seniors, he learns to cope with his friend's suicide and his tumultuous past.
Julie Powell, a young blogger, is determined to emulate Julia Child's cooking techniques. Though separated by time, the two women share a common passion for food that intertwines their lives.
Howard Hughes, a germaphobic inventor with mental illness, creates a new plane. Despite personal struggles, he also becomes a successful filmmaker, balancing aviation and Hollywood pursuits.
Nick Carraway arrives in New York in 1922. Chasing his own American Dream, Nick is drawn into the captivating world of the super-rich, their illusions, loves and deceits.
When a renowned novelist passes unexpectedly, a detective scrutinises the family, uncovering tangled relationships and hidden agendas.
On New Year's Eve, the luxury ocean liner Poseidon capsizes after being swamped by a rogue wave. Later, the survivors are left to fight for their lives as they attempt to escape the sinking ship.

After a stint in a mental institution, former teacher Pat Solitano moves back in with his parents and tries to reconcile with his ex-wife. Things get more challenging when Pat meets Tiffany, a mysterious girl with problems of her own.

programs.description: Two-time Oscar winner Tom Hanks portrays Mr Rogers in a timely story of kindness triumphing over cynicism, based on the true story of the friendship between Fred Rogers and journalist.

When Jim's hypersleep pod malfunctions, he wakes up alone on a doomed ship. Later, he teams up with a fellow passenger, and they race against time to stop a looming disaster before it's too late.

Los Angeles denizen Louis Bloom survives by scavenging and petty theft. He stumbles into a new career as a cameraman and armed with a camcorder and police scanner begins nocturnal forays across the city in search of shocking and grisly crimes. When he catches the eye of a shopworn news director who welcomes the chance to raise her stations ratings Louis goes to increasingly greater lengths to catch the money shot.
